semantic_policy.hard_activation: Only narrow exact event phrases, profile-local contextual exact matches, or a direct requester definition create hard visual duties. Desire, want, wish, longing, yearning, craving, impulse, greed, avarice, envy, jealousy, ambition, power, domination, obsession, fixation, compulsion, conatus, epithymia, tanha, lobha, and kama remain candidate-only when the visible event mechanism is unspecified.
semantic_policy.visual_actuation: Selected concepts are expressed as one identifiable target, goal, resource, object, share, or audience; the current access, ownership, allocation, progress, or control state; one concrete adult action; one constraint or counterparty; and one localized same-frame consequence. A facial expression, gaze, pose, costume, luxury object, text label, or mood alone is not a substitute.
semantic_policy.claim_boundary: Pixels may support only the visible action, relationship, and immediate consequence. They do not establish private intent, personality, greed as a trait, addiction, mental-health diagnosis, consent, legal guilt, actual social rank, enduring power, or philosophical or religious identity.
semantic_policy.reference_boundary: A supplied portrait may guide only observable adult appearance, hair, face proportions, wardrobe, and framing. It never supplies identity, protected traits, health, personality, occupation, victim or offender status, desire type, greed, ambition, power, obsession, or narrative role.
semantic_policy.judgment_boundary: Prompt and runtime audits establish contract binding only. Every hard visual component must be present in the same delivered image; partial visibility is failure, and requesting-user judgment remains separate.

review_scope: Former prose-only policy and representation declarations preserved without granting runtime authority.
